summary: Verified the BI Food % date-filter bugfix end-to-end. Seeded 4 invoices on Timperley (March-dated/June-uploaded, blank-date/June-uploaded, June-dated/July-uploaded, null-date/June-uploaded) and confirmed both routes.bi._stock_spend_by_location and GET /api/admin/invoices honour invoice_date when present and only fall back to uploaded_at when invoice_date is missing/blank/null. All 6 new tests pass and all 7 regression tests in test_invoices.py still pass. Seed docs cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bi.py and routes/invoices.py now have duplicated date-filter logic (the $or with missing_inv_date fallback). Consider extracting into a shared helper (e.g. invoice_date_window_query(start, end)) to keep the two endpoints from drifting again.

_stock_spend_by_location builds end_upload = end_date + 'T23:59:59.999Z' but uploaded_at is stored as ISO with offset (e.g. 2026-06-10T12:00:00+00:00 from datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()). String-range works in tests because both formats sort lexicographically, but this is fragile if uploaded_at is ever stored as a real BSON Date. Worth a note/refactor.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 4 TEST_DATEBUG_* invoice docs on timperley-altrincham (category=stock) for the test module, removed in module-scoped fixture teardown. Verified 0 TEST_DATEBUG_ docs remain after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_invoice_date_filter.py is now the regression suite for the invoice-date-window bug. It both calls the BI helper directly and hits the public /api/admin/invoices endpoint. If touching that filter again, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_date_filter.py /app/backend/tests/test_invoices.py -v.
rca of the issue: Original query was {'$or': [{invoice_date in window}, {uploaded_at in window}]} — so a March-dated invoice scanned in June matched the second clause and leaked into the June Food %. Fix wraps the uploaded_at clause in an $and with a missing/blank/null check on invoice_date, so uploaded_at is only consulted when invoice_date can't be trusted. Verified: June filter excludes March-dated/June-uploaded invoice (A); March filter includes it; blank-date and null-date invoices uploaded in June still appear under June; June-dated invoice uploaded in July still appears in June; July filter excludes all four seeds.
